title: Prove sharp independent centre triple cost floor (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with an exact finite certificate. Independently changing all three contacts of any induced rank-zero path in the fixed retained 640-input centre graph to nontrivial one-transvection charts has the sharp complete paid-moment floor

```text
Delta(theta) >= 3 - 2^theta + 7^theta - 8^theta > 0,  0<theta<1.
```

This answers the rank-zero path question posed by unpaidmoon in PR6289. One literal path attains the bound for every theta. A paired-label min-plus reduction handles the full independent domain while charging every incident edge. All 408 productive helper targets remain unchanged. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit unpaidmoon / PR6289 for the question, Chris R / Clear1nsight / PR4867 and PR4888 for the graph and earlier coherent/pair ceilings, Cinna Davis / PR4694, PR4698 and PR4690 for the retained-centre ABI/contact model, Cao Yifan / PR4610 for the word, David Ganz / PR4841 for the chart-neighbour framework, and the retained PR4470, E8, Clifford, native, helper, scalar, precision, compiler, zxv and Jacob Alan Sussman lineage. The underlying geometry, min-plus elimination and summation by parts are classical. Predecessor files and notices are unchanged; their screens are not replayed as this contribution.

Base: canonical main `2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc`, priority revision 8. TASK.json records the changed card premise. PR6289 at `e41bb20dcc82f3c3d550a5221ee4af0ac940ade5` is citation-only. Four runtime inputs are pinned on canonical main, with no unmerged-object dependency.

## Evidence

Before, the independent connected three-contact case was open after pair and coherent-block results. After, all 496 induced rank-zero paths have the exact componentwise capped-rank minima `(2,1,1,1,1,1,1,0,0)` across 4,464 integer optimization problems. Summation by parts gives the entire theta interval. Path `(11013,11014,11015)` at label `(59,59,59)` has the literal change `{0:-2,1:3,2:-1,7:1,8:-1}` and attains every prefix and the moment floor.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only:

- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass, with identical generated receipts. The full registered two-command replay passes in 6.095 seconds total; individual direct runs took 2.618 and 2.558 seconds. These are verification durations, not a performance claim. Each registered limit is 120 seconds.
- Exact source pins and package metadata pass. Committed bytes, executable modes and source-history preflight pass for all eleven package/input files.
- The checker also passes 1,136 literal small chart-pair comparisons, 99 exhaustive transform oracles and 36 complete six-label path-product oracles. Five invalid inputs, a triangle, three graph-contract mutations and four actual source-byte mutations exercise the assumptions.
- Official export and integrity checks pass. Both complete normal/optimized commands pass from the read-only Git-free export with empty PATH, identical receipts and all twelve exported files unchanged, including its manifest.
- Source compilation, AST/function-size inspection and warning-strict execution pass. Ruff and mypy are unavailable locally; no pass is claimed for them. No proof obligation is delegated to CI.

From the repository root:

Another host may substitute its CPython 3.12. Expected markers are `PASS_INDEPENDENT_CENTRE_TRIPLES`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Set TMPDIR to an existing external scratch directory. Optional `--output /absolute/external/path.json` produces a receipt bound to current package-file hashes. No receipt is hand-written or generated in the checkout.

## Limitations

The result is a sharp source-specific obstruction in an optimistic graph invoice, with unchanged targets. It does not exclude arbitrary finite networks. Four-contact blocks, other original charts, second-step neighbours, changed scalar operations, routes, native maps and helper contracts remain outside scope. No native amplitudes, physical caller/restoration schedule, rounded implementation, precision/tape proof, compiler closure, selected cold replay, Lean or outer theorem was run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The fixed-contact theorem in PR5590 keeps scalar frames fixed; this experiment changes them. PR5324 fixes projection dimensions and owned tariffs, which these empty-chart neighbours change. PR5161's bounded star has fixed owned-centre boundaries and two prescribed leaf alternatives. None supplies this independent retained-centre triple optimization.

## Open next questions

1. Can a connected block of four or more contacts improve the fixed graph invoice? Start with one declared four-vertex tree and the paired-label transform. Cycles need a different joint elimination. No larger certificate or favourable candidate is supplied here.
2. Can a changed chronological operation or route fund a retained-centre caller? First declare literal arbitrary-input endpoints and the complete paid/productive bill. Physical delivery and restoration remain absent.

## Related open work

- PR6289 studies independent pairs on this same retained graph and poses the triple question answered here. Its pair results are credited, not rechecked; this contribution adds the sharp three-contact floor.
- PR4694 supplies the retained 640-field coupled ABI. This contribution prices one chart grammar on its optimistic graph; it does not complete that PR's physical caller or add productive centre credit.
- PR4993 studies a different carried-frame graph after PR4971's swaps. Its 16,199-node invoice is not the 19,197-node source used here, so no numerical comparison is asserted.
- PR6274 speeds the PR4841 mapped-contact predicate caller. Its optimized engine is not imported here; no timing or coverage comparison is made.

- PR6298 studies scalar phase gauges on selected PR6030 MOVE recipes. Its three-edge phase criterion is a different object from this retained-centre graph's paid rank moment.
- PR6302 studies the historical doubled centre Gram and an all-width polynomial annihilator. Its spectral-degree bound does not compute this contact graph's independent triple minimum.
- PR6305 proves a paid-moment obstruction for longer A2 conjugations on the G20 PR5708 word. Its routes, scalar word and invoice differ; no numerical comparison is asserted.

The completion refresh inspected all sixteen open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR, through PR6313. None of the other fifteen computes this retained graph's independent three-contact minimum. No shared-instance numerical disagreement was identified, and no additional scientific computation checked another submission.
